recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, profile-view portrait of a man wearing a wide-brimmed fedora, characterized by a warm, grainy 1970s film aesthetic. The composition features a prominent rectangular 'hype sticker' in the upper right corner and bold, high-contrast typography placed directly over the subject's hat.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's gaze directed toward the right edge of the frame
Typography color contrasting sharply against the dark felt of the hat
Geometric yellow rectangle balancing the organic curves of the portrait
Grainy texture unifying the photographic and graphic elements
coreInvariants: Warm, desaturated color palette with heavy film grain
Wide-brimmed hat as a central structural element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame in a tight profile shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's face and the dark band of the fedora.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eye, follows the brim of the hat to the title text, then moves to the yellow call-out box in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right third of the image consists of a blurred, warm-toned background providing breathing room for the call-out box.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earthy browns and tans in the clothing and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal/brown of the hat providing a base for text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant lime green for the main title and bright yellow for the call-out box.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, low-saturation photography contrasted with high-saturation graphic overlays.
paletteRestrictions: Must include a distinct lime green (#A4C639) and a primary yellow (#FFD700).

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif and condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Heavy, blocky serifs on the main title
Uniform stroke weight in the display type
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy slab serif for the artist name paired with a condensed sans-serif for promotional details.
graphicDevices: Yellow rectangular box with a double black border to simulate a hype sticker.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif structure of the main title.
Provides the necessary density for the promotional text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A grainy, warm-toned 1970s film photograph of a man in profile wearing a brown fedora and a tan coat, looking to the right against a blurred outdoor background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a lime green slab-serif title across the hat band. In the top right, add a yellow rectangle with a thin black border containing red and green condensed text.

verificationChecks: Is the film grain visible across the entire image?
Does the lime green text pop against the dark hat?
Is the yellow box positioned in the upper right quadrant?

adjustableVariables: Saturation of the lime green text
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
Record label logos in the corners
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no modern digital artifacts are present.
Check that the yellow box has a distinct 'sticker' appearance.
Verify the slab serif is sufficiently bold and heavy.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a warm-toned 70s profile portrait + add a heavy slab-serif title in lime green on the subject's hat + place a yellow 'hype sticker' box in the top right corner.
